source_title: How Do I Pay For The Domestika Plus
snippet_primary: "**The Plus subscription cannot be purchased in cash or via bank transfer (available in Mexico, Colombia and Brazil), as it must have a means of payment that enables automatic renewal."
subject_exact: Domestika help center (article 4417429219345, undated) states Domestika Plus subscription cannot be purchased with cash or bank transfer because automatic renewal requires a card or recurring-capable payment method
local_qualifiers: Domestika Plus subscription requires automatic renewal-capable payment method; cash/bank transfer not accepted for subscriptions even in MX, CO, BR
parser_notes: support.domestika.org article 4417429219345 (undated). Domestika Plus: cash/bank transfer excluded; requires auto-renewal-capable payment method.
